messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning an image-layer ownership shift + privilege-minimization cutover next Tue. Need RBAC for the Buildkite SA and the KMS signing flow. Who currently owns 'base-image' family?

sam: I can pick up base-image ownership. Quick Q: rotation window for KMS key + cosign signing? Also we need audit logs retained 90d for compliance.

kevin: Prefer not to rebuild everything. Proposal: rebuild core images (base-*) only, publish new tags, then rebase downstream in smaller batches. Canary plan: route 5% to canary cluster for 24h.

sec-bot: CVE advisory: CVE-2026-1234 — glibc in alpine:3.18 variants flagged. Affected images under base-image/* — https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-1234

devon: RBAC notes: Buildkite SA needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner and storage.objectViewer. We'll gate with condition on serviceAccount in infra org. @sam can you open the IAM change request?

amy: snippet for binding (apply with infra-iam job):
```
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "bk_kms_signer" {
  project = "redwood-infra"
  role    = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
  members = ["serviceAccount:buildkite@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

sam: will open PR shortly and add the audit sink. For audit export run:
```
gcloud logging sinks create sec-audit-exports storage.googleapis.com/redwood-sec-audit-bucket --log-filter="protoPayload.authenticationInfo.serviceAccountEmail:buildkite@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```
Retention policy on the bucket = 365 days.

kevin: deploy window suggestion: Tue 03:00 UTC. Also need a designated image signing owner on deploy — @olivia you ok to be signer?

olivia: Yep I can sign. Will use an asymmetric key in GCP KMS (key ring = redwood-image-signer). I will open PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1234 with the cosign workflow and key IAM.

devon: added to release calendar and outage board. Small ops question — cosign key in KMS only or HSM-backed? Compliance wants HSM if possible.

olivia: We'll provision an asymmetric key with CMEK (HSM-backed) in KMS. Access limited to buildkite SA + a small ops group. I'll add the HSM note in the PR.

sec-bot: Checklist reminder: ensure image SBOMs uploaded, cosign attestation present, and audit sink verified before canary.

sam: ack — I'll follow up with the infra-iam PR and post the link here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
